about: Origin of every file of release/profile-mfg: the shader files of this project's own origin that only the multi-frame build (release/intel_free_mfg.json) ships, in place of a file of release/profile ("replaces") or beside them. Each shader is compiled from HLSL under src/kernels/ with the recipe in "build"; release/build_profile.py check compiles it again and compares the bytes. None of these files holds model weights: the kernels read the coefficients of the network at run time from the buffers Intel's XeSS Frame Generation runtime creates, re-laid out by the add-on's model owner. The same bytes are the files of inputs.lock.json tree group "profile-intel-free-mfg" (origin "own").
toolchain: inputs.lock.json toolchain "profile": Microsoft DirectX Shader Compiler v1.9.2607 for Linux (release asset, sha256 pinned there)

verified.result: 62 of 62 shaders rebuilt byte-identical from the recorded HLSL recipes with the pinned DXC; 25 bounded forms use coordinate-redirection loads.
